    ELSE NULL
  END AS computed_value,
  target_table.Title AS actual_value
FROM Document AS target_table
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT y.DocumentNode,
         CASE
           WHEN INSTR(y.gc, '||') > 0
             THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(y.gc, '||', 1), ' and ', SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(y.gc, '||', 2), '||', -1))
           ELSE y.gc
         END AS noun_phrase
  FROM (
    SELECT pd.DocumentNode,
           GROUP_CONCAT(
             DISTINCT
             CASE
               WHEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(pm.Name, p.Name), ' ', -1)) = 'Crankarm' THEN 'Crank Arm'
               ELSE TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(pm.Name, p.Name), ' ', -1))
             END
             ORDER BY

                 ELSE TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(pm.Name, p.Name), ' ', -1))

    FROM ProductDocument pd
    LEFT JOIN Product p ON p.ProductID = pd.ProductID
    LEFT JOIN ProductModel pm ON pm.ProductModelID = p.ProductModelID
    WHERE pd.DocumentNode IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pd.DocumentNode
  ) y

formula: For a given series (year = y, losing team = L), the winner?s losses in that series equal the losing team?s total postseason wins in that season minus the wins that same team collected in earlier series it won in that season. Formally: L = SUM_coaches(post_wins for (y, L)) - SUM_series_post(W for rows with (year = y AND tmIDWinner = L)). Because a team appears as 'loser' only in its final series of that postseason, all of its other series in that season are wins and are captured by the second term.
computation_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(IFNULL(loser_coach_wins.total_post_wins, 0) AS SIGNED) - CAST(IFNULL(loser_prior_series_wins.total_prior_wins, 0) AS SIGNED) AS computed_value,
  target_table.L AS actual_value
FROM series_post AS target_table
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT year, tmID AS team, SUM(COALESCE(post_wins, 0)) AS total_post_wins
  FROM coaches
  GROUP BY year, tmID
) AS loser_coach_wins
  ON loser_coach_wins.year = target_table.year
 AND loser_coach_wins.team = target_table.tmIDLoser
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT year, tmIDWinner AS team, SUM(COALESCE(W, 0)) AS total_prior_wins
  FROM series_post
  GROUP BY year, tmIDWinner
) AS loser_prior_series_wins
  ON loser_prior_series_wins.year = target_table.year
 AND loser_prior_series_wins.team = target_table.tmIDLoser;

formula: For each employee, take S = Employee.State. Among all Customer rows where State = S, select the Country that appears most frequently (mode); if there is a tie, choose the lexicographically smallest Country. Set Employee.Country = that value.
computation_sql:
SELECT
  mapping.Country AS computed_value,
  target_table.Country AS actual_value
FROM Employee AS target_table
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT cs.StateKey, MIN(cs.Country) AS Country
  FROM (
    SELECT State AS StateKey, Country, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM Customer
    WHERE State IS NOT NULL AND Country IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY State, Country
  ) AS cs
  JOIN (
    SELECT StateKey, MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt
    FROM (
      SELECT State AS StateKey, Country, COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM Customer
      WHERE State IS NOT NULL AND Country IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY State, Country
    ) AS cx
    GROUP BY StateKey
  ) AS cmax
    ON cs.StateKey = cmax.StateKey AND cs.cnt = cmax.max_cnt
  GROUP BY cs.StateKey
) AS mapping
  ON mapping.StateKey = target_table.State;

formula: Compute Teams.playoff from inter-table postseason outcomes using SeriesPost as follows (highest-precedence rule first): 1) If the team participated in a Stanley Cup Final (SCF) series in that year with note = 'ND' (No Decision), return 'ND'. 2) Else if the team won an SCF series, return 'SC'. 3) Else if the team lost an SCF series, return 'F'. 4) Else if the team won the WHA Avco Cup Final (ACF), return 'AVC'. 5) Else if the team lost the WHA ACF, return 'AVF'. 6) Else if the team lost a Stanley Cup Semifinal (SCSF), return 'SCSF'. 7) Else if the team lost a Conference Final (CF), return 'CF'. 8) Else if the team lost a Semifinal (SF), return 'AVSF' if lgID='WHA' (WHA semifinal exit), otherwise 'SF'. 9) Else if the team lost a Division Final (DF), return 'DF'. 10) Else if the team lost a Division Semifinal (DSF), return 'DSF'. 11) Else if the team lost a Quarterfinal (QF), return 'QF'. 12) Else if the team lost a Preliminary round ('Pre' or 'Prelim'), return 'Pre'. Otherwise NULL.
computation_sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN sc_nd.flag = 1 THEN 'ND'
    WHEN sc_win.flag = 1 THEN 'SC'
    WHEN sc_lose.flag = 1 THEN 'F'
    WHEN avc_win.flag = 1 THEN 'AVC'
    WHEN avc_lose.flag = 1 THEN 'AVF'
    WHEN scsf_lose.flag = 1 THEN 'SCSF'
    WHEN cf_lose.flag = 1 THEN 'CF'
    WHEN (sf_lose.flag = 1 AND target_table.lgID = 'WHA') THEN 'AVSF'
    WHEN sf_lose.flag = 1 THEN 'SF'
    WHEN df_lose.flag = 1 THEN 'DF'
    WHEN dsf_lose.flag = 1 THEN 'DSF'
    WHEN qf_lose.flag = 1 THEN 'QF'
    WHEN pre_lose.flag = 1 THEN 'Pre'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS computed_value,
  target_table.playoff AS actual_value
FROM Teams target_table
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT year, tmID, lgID, 1 AS flag
  FROM (
    SELECT year, tmIDWinner AS tmID, lgIDWinner AS lgID FROM SeriesPost WHERE round = 'SCF' AND note = 'ND'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year, tmIDLoser  AS tmID, lgIDLoser  AS lgID FROM SeriesPost WHERE round = 'SCF' AND note = 'ND'
  ) s
  GROUP BY year, tmID, lgID
) sc_nd ON sc_nd.year = target_table.year AND sc_nd.tmID = target_table.tmID AND sc_nd.lgID = target_table.lgID
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT year, tmID, lgID, 1 AS flag
  FROM (
    SELECT year, tmIDWinner AS tmID, lgIDWinner AS lgID FROM SeriesPost WHERE round = 'SCF' AND (note IS NULL OR note <> 'ND')
  ) s
  GROUP BY year, tmID, lgID
) sc_win ON sc_win.year = target_table.year AND sc_win.tmID = target_table.tmID AND sc_win.lgID = target_table.lgID
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT year, tmID, lgID, 1 AS flag
  FROM (
    SELECT year, tmIDLoser AS tmID, lgIDLoser AS lgID FROM SeriesPost WHERE round = 'SCF' AND (note IS NULL OR note <> 'ND')
  ) s
  GROUP BY year, tmID, lgID
) sc_lose ON sc_lose.year = target_table.year AND sc_lose.tmID = target_table.tmID AND sc_lose.lgID = target_table.lgID
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT year, tmID, lgID, 1 AS flag
  FROM (
    SELECT year, tmIDWinner AS tmID, lgIDWinner AS lgID FROM SeriesPost WHERE round = 'ACF'

formula: PostSHG (Playoff Shorthanded Goals) is derived by counting the number of playoff games in the CombinedShutouts table where the player (identified by playerID in Scoring) participated as a goalie (IDgoalie1 or IDgoalie2) and the game was marked as a playoff (R/P = 'P').
computation_sql: SELECT target_table.playerID, target_table.year, target_table.stint, target_table.tmID, target_table.lgID, target_table.PostSHG AS actual_value, COALESCE(subquery.computed_value, 0) AS computed_value FROM Scoring AS target_table LEFT JOIN (SELECT cs.IDgoalie1 AS playerID, cs.year, COUNT(*) AS computed_value FROM CombinedShutouts AS cs WHERE cs.`R/P` = 'P' GROUP BY cs.IDgoalie1, cs.year UNION ALL SELECT cs.IDgoalie2 AS playerID, cs.year, COUNT(*) AS computed_value FROM CombinedShutouts AS cs WHERE cs.`R/P` = 'P' GROUP BY cs.IDgoalie2, cs.year) AS subquery ON target_table.playerID = subquery.playerID AND target_table.year = subquery.year WHERE target_table.pos = 'G';

computation_sql: SELECT target_table.playerID, target_table.year, target_table.tmID, target_table.PostSOG AS actual_value, IFNULL(shutouts_subquery.computed_value, 0) AS computed_value FROM Scoring AS target_table LEFT JOIN (SELECT cs.IDgoalie1 AS playerID, cs.year, cs.tmID, COUNT(*) AS computed_value FROM CombinedShutouts AS cs WHERE cs.`R/P` = 'P' GROUP BY cs.IDgoalie1, cs.year, cs.tmID UNION ALL SELECT cs.IDgoalie2 AS playerID, cs.year, cs.tmID, COUNT(*) AS computed_value FROM CombinedShutouts AS cs WHERE cs.`R/P` = 'P' GROUP BY cs.IDgoalie2, cs.year, cs.tmID) AS shutouts_subquery ON target_table.playerID = shutouts_subquery.playerID AND target_table.year = shutouts_subquery.year AND target_table.tmID = shutouts_subquery.tmID WHERE target_table.pos = 'G';
